name: Case law: United States, the Supreme Court of Wyoming
label: United States case law (the Supreme Court of Wyoming)
coverage: 10897 published decisions, one file each, dated the day decided: 10895 with their opinion text and 2 with CAP head matter only (CAP holds no opinion text for them); 73 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. Read from P.2d, P.3d, Wyo.. The head matter (syllabi, headnotes, counsel) is left out: it is the publisher's text, not the court's. Every decision is a published opinion (precedential_status: published); CAP records no other status. CAP is a closed archive (its last volumes are of 2018-2020): no nightly runner appends to this repo. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.
update: none: the Caselaw Access Project is a static archive, so no nightly runner is registered

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)

relations.same-decision-as: the file is the same decision as the target (same day, docket or name, and text); both are kept
relations.moved-to: the decision was routed here by mistake and is now at the target (<repo>/<path>); this file was removed

decision_dates.note: decisions whose CAP date gives only the month or the year (precision month or year): committed on the first day of it, In-force likewise
